title: Trial of Execution
summary: Save the prisoner from execution through four waves, then defeat Prime Executioner Vathoch.
overview: Save the prisoner from execution through four waves, then defeat Prime Executioner Vathoch.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Each wave brings four enemies while the executioner moves toward the prisoner. The executioner moves faster with each new wave.
Killing a wave enemy interrupts the executioner and sends it back when more enemies remain. Use those kills to buy time, then finish the wave.
Do not allow the executioner to remain at the prisoner. Its execution timer causes the trial to fail.
After the fourth wave is cleared, defeat Vathoch to complete the trial.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
